### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Report only patient-stated history, habits, or current status. Do not infer past or present conditions/behaviors from future advice or agreements to follow instructions.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Strictly adhere to patient-stated information; if a detail is not explicitly mentioned by the patient, omit it entirely from the Subjective section rather than stating its absence or inferring it from other parts of the transcript (e.g., doctor's advice or patient's agreement to follow instructions).

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Accurately report patient-stated symptoms, distinguishing between affirmations and denials (e.g., 'has chills' vs. 'denies chills').
[A]: Limit assessment of complications to those explicitly stated by the provider as complicating factors for the current condition. Do not infer complications from general patient history or symptoms used for diagnosis.
[P]: Link follow-up appointment reasons directly to the specific purpose stated by the provider. Do not combine general health management advice with specific appointment objectives unless explicitly stated.
